'Jadikan lead semua (6)' → 'Lead baru 6, Dilewati 1' then button shows (0) and disabled; /leads 'Capture dari WA' navigates to /wa-capture; /inbox shows SIMULASI pill + sr-only mode badge, window badge 'Sesi 24 jam aktif · sisa 23:59' (inbox-window-remaining), outgoing message shows inbox-msg-status 'simulasi', un-linked conversation shows inbox-conv-capture-btn → dialog → 'Lead baru 1' → panel switches to lead context (stage/score/source/NBA) and capture button disappears; /config tab 'Integrasi WhatsApp': 5 credential fields (token/app_secret/verify_token = password type), mode select, Tes koneksi → honest 'Mode simulasi: tidak ada kredensial yang diuji…', pesan uji → status 'simulated', save verify_token → field cleared + masked placeholder 'qa-v••••••2026' + green check, mode Live without token → toast 400 'Mode live membutuhkan minimal WHATSAPP_TOKEN dan WHATSAPP_PHONE_ID.', checklist go-live & webhook box (URL + last received + signature state) rendered. No React console errors on /wa-capture, /inbox, /config (only the expected 400 from the intentional live-mode save).

ui_bugs.issue: Dialog state is not reset when reopened: only `result` is cleared in the open effect, so policy_lead / policy_customer / assignee / campaign keep the previous run's values. Reproduced: choose 'Lewati' → Batal → reopen for the same row → select still shows 'Lewati'; consequently a subsequent 'Jadikan lead semua' silently skipped the duplicate-lead contact (result 'Dilewati 1') even though the user never re-chose that policy. Reset the form state on open (or persist deliberately and show it in the header).

issues: After a failed live-mode save (400), the Mode select stays on 'Live' locally while the server is still 'simulation' — no visual hint that the shown mode is unsaved; consider reverting to server value on error.

design_issues.screen: /inbox (conversation not yet linked to a lead)
issues: Right panel for un-linked conversations has no data-testid=inbox-context-panel (only inbox-conv-capture-btn); the testid appears only after capture — minor testability gap.

action_items: WaCaptureDialog: reset policy_lead/policy_customer/assignee/campaign when the dialog opens (stale 'Lewati' caused an unintended skip during 'Jadikan lead semua').
Optional: revert Mode select to server value when PUT /api/wa/config returns 400; add data-testid=inbox-context-panel to the un-linked conversation panel.
critical_code_review_comments: WaCaptureDialog useEffect([open, canAssign]) only clears `result`; add setPolicyLead('link'), setPolicyCustomer('create'), setAssignee(''), setCampaign('') for predictable, non-destructive defaults on every open.

context_for_next_testing_agent: WA queue is currently empty (all captured). Use wa-simulate-inbound-btn with random 10-digit local numbers (813xxxxxxx) to create fresh queue rows; PhoneInput accepts local digits only. Duplicate-lead scenario: import an existing lead phone from GET /api/leads. Remember WaCaptureDialog keeps last-selected policy across opens — re-select explicitly in scripts until fixed.
rca_of_the_issue: WaCaptureDialog keeps policy/assignee/campaign in component state that is never reinitialised on `open` (the effect resets only `result`), so the last used duplicate policy leaks into the next capture (including bulk/all), producing 'Dilewati' instead of the documented default 'Tautkan ke lead lama'.
